attempts_summary: Single continuous session, ~10 logical iterations (one per ranked target, in the specified blocking order). One real bug found and fixed mid-implementation via the loop's own smoke-testing discipline: orig_index (source wide-dataframe row) was not a unique key per detection across slots sharing a frame, silently collapsing 2 well-separated simultaneous ids into 1 -- caught by an interactive smoke test before it reached the formal pytest suite, fixed by keying on the long-format dataframe's own unique row index instead.

curated_lessons: orig_index (source-row position) is NOT a safe unique key across multiple detections sharing one frame in wide-per-slot/wide-per-marker schemas -- always key merge-tracking dicts on the long-format dataframe's own row index instead.

GeometricFrameLinker's pairwise gate 'dist > max_dist AND iou < min_iou' means min_iou=0.0 disables the distance veto entirely (iou < 0.0 is never true) -- any test/config relying on distance-based rejection needs a small positive min_iou.

Column-by-column assignment into a growing pandas DataFrame inside a loop triggers real PerformanceWarning fragmentation at real-file scale (16 slots x 16k frames) -- build a dict and construct the DataFrame once.

A cleanup-loop condition that references an already-filtered set against the same filter threshold it was filtered by can never fire -- this exact pattern was a real, silent, previously-undetected bug in the shared GeometricFrameLinker.
